newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany prepares bill on energy liberalisation.
newsitem.headline: Germany prepares bill on energy liberalisation.

text.p: Chancellor Helmut Kohl's cabinet is preparing a bill to end regional monopolies for electricity and gas supplies, economics minister Guenter Rexrodt said on Friday.
The bill, which should be ready by September 25, will not undermine the right of local governments to lease rights of way, he said.
"Electricity prices in Germany are too high. We need to lower energy costs through more competition," Rexrodt told a news conference.
The reform will be in line with the June decision by European Union energy ministers to encourage cross-border competition, he said.
